# Repo-owned generator snapshot

This directory is a source snapshot of [TartanLlama/generator](https://github.com/TartanLlama/generator) at commit `2a912502de4f97dcba4f95c958ee0ddf7bc22cf5`, the gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. The original tracked files were copied without source edits from the clean local checkout of that exact commit on 2026-11-07.

The upstream `COPYING` file is retained in full. It applies CC0 1.0 Universal to this source. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata and is not part of the original snapshot.

The Mac build uses this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`. A fresh clone now has this input without initializing a `generator` submodule or contacting its origin. Other third-party inputs remain external until migrated separately.
